annotations.title: Cross-chain coverage gauge (share of DefiLlama bridge volume tracked)

description: How much of all cross-chain volume ASPERN tracks (2026-11-27). The denominator is DefiLlama’s bridge volume (every bridge adapter, 24h, 7d or 30d, de-duplicated: USDT0 and Stargate V2 are inside LayerZero V2), read every six hours, with its source and time on the answer. `percent`: the share carried by the bridges our stored indexes read (Circle CCTP on 24 EVM networks; LayerZero OFT / Stargate, Across, Wormhole, Chainlink CCIP and the Base and OP Mainnet canonical bridges on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and OP Mainnet), against the 80 % target (`meetsTarget`); `totals.bridgesTracked` of `totals.bridgesListed`. `untracked`: every bridge we do not index at or above 1 % of the volume, by name, share and why (Relay, Coinbase’s cbBTC, Hyperliquid’s bridge, Circle Gateway …); `longTail`: the smaller ones, by name, with their total. `counted`: what our own indexes count per day against DefiLlama’s per day, because a tracked bridge is not every transfer counted (four networks outside CCTP); per bridge `seenShare`. A bridge whose reader is built but has not read yet is built_not_read and is not counted. `state`: read, not_yet_read or unavailable (never a figure without a snapshot). Never says who moved the volume, that an AI agent acted, or that anything was autonomous. Per day: cross_chain_stats, bridge_stats. FREE.
name: bridge_volume_coverage

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

bridges.description: Per bridge we index: slug, label, mark, networks, status, readSince, listedUsd, share, ours, oursPerDay, listedPerDay, seenShare.

longTail.description: count, usd, share, names of the untracked bridges below 1 %.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

nested.description: Adapters counted inside another, with why.

percent.description: Tracked share 0..1, null without a snapshot.

says.description: One sentence: We track X% of 30-day cross-chain volume (Y of Z bridges); untracked: …

source.description: name, url, page, fetchedAt (when DefiLlama was read), stale, note.

totals.description: listedUsd, trackedUsd, bridgesListed, bridgesTracked, defillamaTotalUsd, nestedRemovedUsd.

untracked.description: slug, name, category, usd, share, status, why: every untracked bridge at or above 1 %.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Cross-chain coverage gauge (share of DefiLlama bridge volume tracked)
